ms.report:
Milestone Completed: Milestone 2 - "Confirm Seamless Operation with Accounting Rules"
Confirmation of Achievement: We confirm the successful completion of Milestone 2. This submission demonstrates that all requirements for the Milestone Outputs, Acceptance Criteria, and Evidence of Milestone Completion, as defined in our proposal, have been fully met.
Summary of Verification:
・P&L Display Verified (Acceptance Criteria 1): The system correctly displays Profit & Loss (P&L) calculation results, including Market Value, Acquisition Cost, and P/L, within the transaction details view. This was verified using the specified test wallet.
・P&L Calculation Accuracy Verified (Acceptance Criteria 2): The P&L calculations are confirmed to be accurate, implementing the formula (P/L = Current Market Value - Acquisition Cost) and using the moving average method for cost basis calculation. The system correctly handles the accounting logic for both income (updating cost basis) and expenditure (calculating P/L) transactions.

Evidence & Links:
・Detailed Proof of Achievement (Google Doc):

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Wb-Mymm7BpiU2FQ_rXff2OaHi2YLJQb6HXKKG0GEN5w/edit?usp=sharing
・This document provides comprehensive details, including verification procedures, step-by-step walkthroughs, screenshots, and specific calculation examples satisfying all acceptance criteria.

・Development Environment URL (Required Evidence): https://app.rikyu.io/login

・The test account login credentials required to access the environment are included within the Google Doc linked above.

ms.report:
Milestone Completed
Milestone 3 - "Release to Production Environment"
Confirmation of Achievement
We confirm the successful completion of Milestone 3. This submission demonstrates that all requirements for the Milestone Outputs, Acceptance Criteria, and Evidence of Milestone Completion, as defined in our proposal, have been fully met.
Summary of Achievement & Activities
Bug Fixes and Final Verification (Acceptance Criteria 1)
We completed the final bug check prior to the production release on March 20, and confirmed that there were no issues.
Per the acceptance criteria, we confirmed that no critical bugs were identified during the final deployment checks for this production release. The major bug fix (Cardano staking rewards double-counting issue) was implemented in Milestone 1.
In Milestone 1, we also identified and fixed an issue concerning the timing of staking reward recognition. Because Cardano rewards are determined per epoch but require manual withdrawal, we decided—consistent with accounting principles—to recognize revenue at the time of reward confirmation rather than at the time of actual withdrawal.
Verification items across milestones
Milestone 1 Verification Items
- Successful Cardano wallet integration
- Accurate detection of the following transaction types:
 * Gas fees
 * Fund transfers
 * Swap transactions
 * Native token transfers
 * Staking rewards
 * NFT transfers
- Verification of ADA balance consistency between the application and blockchain explorers (a critical indicator of transaction accuracy)
Milestone 2 Verification Items
- Profit/loss calculation accuracy
- Cost basis calculation accuracy
During the final verification for Milestone 3, we confirmed that all the above items function properly without issues.
Note: For detailed verification flows and results from Milestones 1 and 2, please refer to the respective Proof of Achievement (PoA) submissions. Milestone 3 focuses specifically on the successful deployment to the production environmen

・✅The Help content is created in Japanese (initial users are expected to be Japanese; reviewers may use browser auto-translation if needed).

・✅The Help page includes a list of supported transaction types for the Cardano chain.

Note: 
Thank you for the review. We would like to clarify the timeline and request reconsideration.
Although the proposal has been active for more than 1 year, the milestone work started in November 2024 as part of a planned ~10-month schedule. The deliverable for this milestone (Cardano Help documentation) was publicly launched on July 15, 2025 and has been available to Cardano users; the delay was in our Proof of Achievement submission, not in delivering the output to users. The ~2-month delay beyond the May 2025 milestone deadline was mainly due to migrating our Help Center from a Notion-based simple site to a more robust custom-domain Help Center. The scope and acceptance criteria were not changed, so we believe a Change Request is not necessary.
